Motion proof: eight frames across the scroll timeline

Scroll position becomes one number between 0 and 1. The heat rises through the first screen between 0 and 0.22; the seven overtone rings are struck between 0.30 and 0.58. Every frame below is the same page at a different value of that number, captured in a real browser. Under prefers-reduced-motion the number is pinned to 1 and nothing animates.
